'''Cele-B-R-A-T-E''' is the ending theme for the English [[dub]] of ''[[M04|Celebi: The Voice of the Forest]]''. It is performed by [[Russell Velázquez]]. The song's title is a portmanteau of {{p|Celebi}} and ''celebrate''.
